quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign shape mean?
questions.explanation: A pennant-shaped sign marks the start of a no passing zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that traffic may merge from the right. Be ready to let other vehicles merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black lettering or symbols. They tell you about road conditions ahead. This sign warns that the road will be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turn on red light permitted with caution.
All traffic must turn right at next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell you the traffic laws you must follow. You must drive in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left. Left turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs mark school zones and school crossings. Watch for children and follow the posted speed limits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns of a steep hill. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to situations ahead. This sign warns of an upcoming intersection so you can prepare for traffic or to turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a pedestrian crosswalk. Watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A triangular red and white sign means you must yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a side road intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers that bicycles may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange sign warns that roadwork is ahead. Stay alert for temporary traffic control devices in work zones.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is a traffic law. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always means a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery and dangerous when wet. Slow down on wet pavement because it takes longer to stop.

questions.question: What does a flashing red traffic light mean?

options.text: Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.
Only stop to yield to other traffic.
Vehicles will be entering the roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means the same as a stop sign. You must stop completely, yield to all crossing traffic and pedestrians, then proceed when safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A side road enters from the left.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a yield sign is coming. Start to slow down when you see this warning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane is ending ahead. Drivers in that lane must merge into another lane.

questions.question: What do orange background signs mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs are used only for construction and maintenance warnings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign warns drivers about a school zone or school crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign says that U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What should you do at this red and white sign?

options.text: Stop and check for traffic from both directions before going.
Let traffic on the road you want to enter or cross go first.
Keep a steady speed and check for traffic from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let traffic on the road you want to enter or cross go first.
questions.explanation: A three-sided yield sign means you must slow down and be ready to stop if needed. Let any vehicles, bicycles, or pedestrians pass before you go. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let traffic crossing your path go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let traffic crossing your path go first.
questions.explanation: When you see this sign, you must yield. Slow down and let vehicles and pedestrians cross in front of you before you go. Stop if you need to.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about hazards ahead. Round signs warn only about railroad crossings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to immediate hazards. This sign warns that you are leaving a separated one-way road and will soon drive on a two-way road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street going the wrong way.
You can go ahead if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street going the wrong way.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road, entrance, or exit. If you see this sign facing you, traffic is coming toward you. Turn around if you are driving toward this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black symbols. This sign warns you that the road will split into separate directions ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that two lanes will soon become one lane. Be ready to merge safely.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns you that pedestrians may cross the road ahead. Slow down and watch for people crossing.

questions.question: When you see this road sign, you should:
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns that a divided highway is starting. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a side road will join your road ahead. Be alert for vehicles entering from the side.

questions.question: A diamond-shaped sign means:
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers about hazards or special conditions ahead. They are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: What message will be found on a red octagon-shaped sign?
questions.explanation: An octagon (eight-sided) sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted where you cannot enter. Do not drive past this sign. You may see it on one-way streets or expressway ramps going the wrong direction.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you pedestrians may cross the road ahead. Slow down and watch for people.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is on the back of very slow vehicles, such as farm equipment or construction machinery, that move slower than 25 mph.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that the right lane is ending. Be ready for traffic to merge.

questions.question: What does this yellow warning sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive with caution, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed near schools. It warns drivers to slow down, be careful, and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that the right lane is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that traffic from the right is about to merge. Be ready to let them in safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabilities. Only vehicles with disability plates or placards may park here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road may be slippery when wet. Drive with extra caution.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you:

options.text: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
Will always stop at the upcoming railroad crossing.
Should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a railroad crossing is ahead. Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop if a train is coming.

questions.question: This sign warns you that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: This round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down, look and listen, and be ready to stop for trains.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that your road will end at an intersection ahead. Slow down and be ready to yield or stop before turning right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and do not use your brakes.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has a series of turns or curves.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns you to drive carefully in wet conditions because the pavement will be slippery and harder to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must go either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must go either right or left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road splits ahead and you must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should stop for other traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road. Give extra space so drivers can merge safely into traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should keep right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is entering from another road. Give extra space so drivers can merge safely into traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic will merge into your lane. Check your side and rear mirrors, then move to another lane if possible to give merging drivers a clear path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean about the road ahead?

options.text: It turns sharply right, then left.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of a reverse curve where the road curves to the right, then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: A curve in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions immediately ahead. This sign warns you that the road curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Slow down to 35 mph or less before the upcoming curve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down to 35 mph or less before the upcoming curve.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions immediately ahead. Speed advisory signs show the safe speed for the upcoming condition.

questions.question: This sign is a __________ sign.
questions.explanation: A downward-pointing triangle sign means you must yield. Slow down to a safe speed and stop if needed. If you stop, do so at a marked stop line.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions immediately ahead. This sign warns you that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: What is this symbol used for?
questions.explanation: A reflective orange triangle on the back of a vehicle means it travels slowly. You may see this on farm equipment, roadwork vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. It looks orange during the day and red at night.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The right lane ends soon. Merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends soon. Merge left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the number of lanes ahead is decreasing and traffic must move to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black lettering or symbols. They tell drivers about upcoming road conditions. This sign warns that traffic is merging ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep downgrade ahead. Check your brakes.

questions.question: What does an orange sign like this mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs show construction areas. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign means a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: The stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on any road. When you see a stop sign, you must stop completely. Do not proceed until the way is clear and you can safely pass through the intersection.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop, whether or not there is a stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs warn you that a school zone or school crossing is ahead. Be alert and ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white with red and black markings. They inform drivers of traffic laws in that area. This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road changes direction or narrows.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road changes direction or narrows.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a change in road direction or a narrowing road. You may see these signs on sharp curves or near narrow bridges.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic lights from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights are ordered from top to bottom as red, yellow, and green. Red is always on top, yellow in the middle, and green on the bottom.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What kind of sign is this?
questions.explanation: A downward-facing triangle is a yield sign. When you see it, slow down or stop if needed to let other traffic go first.

questions.question: What does a solid red arrow in a traffic signal mean?

options.text: Drivers must come to a complete stop.
Drivers may proceed through the intersection with caution.
Drivers must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: A solid red arrow means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for a green arrow or green light to turn in that direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign always means stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that the divided highway is ending. Get ready to move to a different lane position.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will have curves ahead. Be ready to adjust your speed.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this yellow sign?

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guard signals for you to go.
Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow sign means you are near a school. Watch for children and be ready to stop if they are crossing.

questions.question: You see this sign at a railroad crossing with no signal. What should you do?

options.text: Proceed at a consistent speed while looking and listening for approaching trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing without signals, slow down and look both ways. Listen for trains and be ready to stop. Never try to drive faster than a train.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear orange or yellow vests, yellow-green shirts, or bright jackets. They use paddles and red flags to direct traffic through work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can turn right on a red light.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection. Turning right here is illegal.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid crashes and brake damage.

questions.question: This white sign means you should not pass other vehicles:

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: White rectangular signs show rules you must obey. This sign means never pass other vehicles here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can turn left only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means left turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the marked line. If there is no line, stop at the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop before the intersection where you can see traffic coming.

questions.question: What does this sign show?

options.text: The distance from the road to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal vehicle height in this state.
The maximum vehicle width allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from the road to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of low clearance. It shows the distance from the road surface to the bottom of a bridge or overpass.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left then right.
The road curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right then left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road will curve right, then curve left. Slow down to navigate the curves safely.

questions.question: What does a solid yellow traffic light mean?

options.text: The light is about to turn red.
The light is about to turn green.
Stop and wait for traffic to pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: The light is about to turn red.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow light warns that the signal is changing to red. Slow down and stop before the intersection if you can do so safely. If you are already in the intersection, continue through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a divided highway begins ahead. Stay to the right of the median divider.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is a detour to the right because of road construction.
The road ahead makes a sharp turn at a steep angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead makes a sharp turn at a steep angle.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about conditions ahead. This sign tells you to slow down for a sharp turn.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Drive at your normal speed.
Look and listen. Be ready to stop if needed.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look and listen. Be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, you must look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about conditions ahead. This sign warns about a winding road coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black lettering or symbols. They warn drivers about upcoming road conditions. This sign warns that a railroad crossing is coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers what traffic laws they must follow. This sign says you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you are leaving a divided highway and entering a two-way road.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you should stop and:

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction you plan to go, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must come to a full stop and look both ways before you go.

questions.question: What does an orange and red triangular sign on a vehicle mean?
questions.explanation: Farm tractors, road maintenance vehicles, and animal-drawn carts display an orange and red triangle on the back to show they move slowly.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert you to hazards ahead. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic may merge into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed. You may see this sign where heavy traffic comes from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed on vehicles that move slowly.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic may merge into your lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs, cones, and barrels mark work zones. Stay alert for unexpected driving conditions. This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead. You must follow the flagger's directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a stop sign is coming up ahead.
